schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Lely Aquatic Park Pond (Region 2, Glenn Co.) for catchable-size Rainbow Trout under the Put and Take program, with a stated release month range of April-June.
